name: Demo G7: Delete Manual Balancing Damper Redline
description: Exercise a delete-like redline operation for a modeled MEP accessory using the family-instance evidence contract: create a disposable manual balancing damper/accessory, prove its requested type and visibility, delete it with native dry-run/apply evidence, prove it is absent, and write a deterministic visual gate.
setup_instructions: Open a disposable Revit model or a model that can be closed without saving.
Use a view, level, and MEP accessory family/type that can be safely placed and deleted.

For the first live smoke, use a low-risk level-hosted or non-hosted damper/accessory symbol. Host-aware duct accessory placement remains a later live hardening step if the active damper family requires duct hosting.
success_criteria: A disposable MEP accessory family instance id is created in the model.
The native create result returns family/type/name evidence matching the requested manual balancing damper/accessory symbol.
The created accessory id is visible in the pre-delete visible-element inventory.
Native delete dry-run and apply effect evidence include the created accessory id.
The post-delete visible-element inventory no longer contains the accessory id.
A deterministic delete visual gate artifact passes using before/after capture evidence.
failure_criteria: The accessory is not created or is created as a different requested type.
The pre-delete visible-element inventory does not contain the created accessory id.
Delete dry-run or apply omits the accessory id from effect evidence.
The post-delete visible-element inventory still contains the accessory id.
The delete visual gate artifact is missing or fails.
grader_notes: This task is the first explicit MEP accessory delete benchmark, targeted at manual balancing damper redlines.
Do not count requestedIds-only delete responses as evidence; delete must return ids, deletedIds, or impactedIds.
